name: Turn only the correct shelf into one human answer
hypothesis: Can Qwen3-8B turn the complete USED shelf into one clear answer without seeing alternatives, dropping a required part, or inventing a new fact?

writer.system: You are a careful technical writer. Use only the supplied USED shelf. Never add a competing view, general advice, or a fact not stated there.
writer.instruction: Write one short, natural answer to the question. Include every part supported by the USED shelf: the cause or explicit uncertainty, and the safe action or next measurement. Connect a conditional action only when another supplied fragment establishes its condition. Return exactly one JSON object: {"answer":"...","evidence_ids":["SOURCE_ID"]}. Cite every supplied fragment that supports the answer and no other ID.
writer.input_policy: The writer receives the question and USED fragments only. SAME_CASE and OTHER are not in its context.

boundaries: These are the same synthetic English questions already used in Gates 15A–15E.
The USED shelf is already known to contain the correct sixty pieces.
This tests only final writing from a correct shelf, not routing, retrieval, sender honesty, unseen data, or physical transport.
Manual semantic review is required; exact string matching is not the judge.
